string_values: Partial eastern South Pacific103–88W reach near historical STF-crossing context. Historical P18/P19 fronts were observed in different years; they do not establish one simultaneous velocity axis. Exclude western basin/Chatham Rise, ACC export branches, Chile-Peru coastal flow, northward recirculation and independent split bands as targets. Geographic eastward maxima do not independently validate named-current/front/branch membership. The14C-at150m frontal criterion and3000m dynamic-height reference are not current depth boundaries; no thermal gate is used.
Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.

Exclude Leeuwin flow west of eastern Bight, Zeehan off Tasmania, gulf outflows and summer westward reversal as target identities. January and July eastward component outcomes remain separate; no sign flip or forced winter continuity. Shallow shelf exclusion and offshore eddy/recirculation contamination are explicit limitations. Fixed eastward component is not local along-slope flow or an independently identified warm-saline core.

temporal_scope: Southern reaches January/July2022; countercurrents March/June/September/December2022. All exact15th00Zsnapshots, not seasonal means or annual extrema. Countercurrent frozen transport prose20targets does not relabel its verified40-case matrix.
method: Distinct original components/primary cutoffs and paired depth shapes; all58cases in one cumulative descriptor query.
cutoff_interpretation: Reaches retain5cm/s primary with2cm/s surface selection; countercurrents retain10cm/s primary without positive surface/relative gate. Sensitivities are not replacement primaries. Source graph topology and adapter metadata preserved without physical-body inference.
window_interpretation: Classic inherited or explicit owner0-200m strata select cores, not measured thickness, tracing caps, thermocline, sample/instrument limits or seabed.
layer_metric_interpretation: Paired thickness lower minus upper, not absolute lower depth or core depth. Contiguous native minimum span is conditional component-model support, not physical body bound. Missing/censored remain null, not zero or absent currents.
range_interpretation: Native sampling-bracket scenarios are not confidence intervals, physical uncertainty or annual envelopes.
identity_scope: Separate eastern SouthPacific103-88W, SouthAustralian135.5-142.5E, IndianSECC93-97E and PacificSECC168-172E contexts. Historical fronts/core depths/instrument/geostrophic reference limits do not impose current bottoms. IndianSECC lies east of selected90E atlas handoff, no route extrapolation. No parent depths or basin/family bodies inherited or added.
interpretation: Partial fixed-axis component geometry is not independently flow-normal/fullwidth/wholebody. No joining sections, terrain clearance, geographic identity proof or physical volume.
